sources.title: Benning blueberry harvest — NSW DPI article, Autumn 2024, pages 53–58
sources.enumerated_scope: All six original PDF pages, printed 53–58, including photo captions. No cultivar is named. Rabbiteye is a blueberry type; KATO260 is grading equipment. Neither is a cultivar or selection code. This is a bounded article check, not a complete Benning portfolio.
sources.limitations: Autumn 2024 article by Gaius Leong, NSW Department of Primary Industries, about mechanical harvesting at the Benning operation. No named cultivar, alias, breeder/owner role, legal right, approved trait or growing footprint is established. Operational and labor comparisons are attributed observations, not a general benchmark. Photographs are credited to NSW DPI; reuse permission is not established, so they remain in the linked original and are not extracted or hosted as site images. The existing unverified company identifier and earlier About-page capture are unchanged.
review_warnings: No cultivar names are given in this article; the company variety list remains incomplete.
NSW DPI photo credit is visible, but permission to reuse the photographs is not established. Open the original to inspect them.
